old: A 1988 10-yen coin from Japan. One side shows the Phoenix Hall of Byodoin temple with the country name (日本国) and value (十円). The other side shows a large 10, an evergreen bay laurel (tokiwa) wreath, and the Japanese Showa-era date (昭和 63, which is 1988; 昭和 57 is 1982). It is made of bronze (95% copper, 3–4% zinc, and 1–2% tin).
